# Trademarks

## Overview
This page documents the preliminary legal review and trademark clearance findings for various product and feature marks associated with [Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md), [TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md), and related collaborative projects between Mira Chen and Alex Kim.

## Key Details
* **[MeshSync](./meshsync.md):** Cleared for use, subject to a caveat regarding similar mesh [IoT](./iot.md) marks.
* **TeaBuddy:** Cleared for use in class 21 (kitchen gadgets).
* **"Puck":** Considered a crowded mark when used alone; must be used together as "TeaBuddy Puck".
* **"SteepSync":** Prohibited for use (previously rejected internally by Alex Kim).
* **"Nova":** Conflicts with an existing tech mark when used alone; must be used in combination as "[Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md)".
* **Co-marketing Guidelines:** Co-marketing activities are approved provided that logos maintain a minimum separation of 24px.
